environment_disclosed_truthfully.why_it_matters_for_this_lane: the governed environment named by commission is missing, and the shared-store environment law forbids silently recreating one and calling it governed. This lane did not recreate anything; it used an already-existing environment whose freeze is set-identical to the governed lock and labelled every result accordingly.
environment_disclosed_truthfully.relevance_to_the_claims: the binding is PURE SOURCE-FREE LOGIC over synthetic exact refs. It reads no survey bytes, no file and no network. The environment therefore affects only whether the test harness can import and execute, not the semantics under test. No result in this return depends on the missing environment for its correctness.

determinism.conclusion: deterministic and hash-seed independent; run 3 exists specifically so determinism is not an artifact of a single fixed seed

regression_slice.definition: every rawlsing_next/tests file importing the touched or imported surface: pre553_service_source_applicability, source_backed_positioned_subject_possibility, objective_consumer_bounded_evidence, pre553_empirical_objects, pre553_empirical_authority
regression_slice.method: controlled before/after on the SAME 66 pre-existing files. The two new files were moved out of the tree to establish the baseline, __pycache__ purged, and the identical file list re-run. Failure and error identity was then compared as SORTED SETS, not by aggregate count.
regression_slice.conclusion: ZERO REGRESSION. The binding seam introduces no new failure and no new collection error anywhere in the imported surface.
regression_slice.honesty_note_on_the_78_and_50: these 78 failures and 50 collection errors are PRE-EXISTING on this lineage at the commissioned tip and are identical with and without my change. They are dominated by absent optional dependencies (notably duckdb), missing fixture/corpus material, and known absent modules. This lane neither caused nor repaired them and makes no claim that the wider surface is green.
regression_slice.the_78_and_50_are_not_mine_to_fix: the commission scoped this lane to one thin seam and forbade modifying adopted owners. Repairing the wider surface would require production backports and fixture material that are explicitly out of scope.

write_terrain_verification.verified_independently_of_the_court: by git hash-object in the shell as well as inside the court
write_terrain_verification.note: the commission permitted a minimal wiring change to an adopted owner only if exact implementation proved it unavoidable, and required stopping to report a named blocker rather than silently editing. No such need arose, so no adopted owner was touched and no blocker is reported.

self_referential_court_avoidance.motivation: the adopted review of the applicability owner (HQ207 03/08, GAP-3) showed a court parametrised over the production constant cannot detect narrowing of that constant.
measures: 25 forbidden purposes are PINNED AS LITERALS in the court; the production tuple is never read, so truncating it makes the court FAIL
non-authorization is additionally proven by recursive value inspection of the emitted binding material for any rank/score/priority/preference/weight/best/first/latest/local leaf or value
unranked-ness is proven by permutation invariance of the binding replay identity across all 6 orderings of a 3-member class, not by a self-declared flag
the returning source-touching surface is pinned separately from the raising refusal surface
the public API is pinned against __all__ rather than bare dir(), because dir() also lists names merely imported into the module

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.defect: the binder compared an ExactRef against a dict keyed by str when validating that a positive decision appears in the admissible set, so every positive decision was wrongly reported absent
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.detected_by: the first smoke run of the positive path
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.class: real binder bug, caught before any court run

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.defect: expose_unranked_admitted_source_set enforced COMPLETE coverage only in EXHAUSTIVE_UNRANKED_SET mode, so a SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION binding over an INCOMPLETE class could hand back a partial set as if it were the admissible set
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.fix: the set-exposure power now requires COMPLETE in EVERY mode, because exposing the set is itself an exhaustive claim
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.class: real binder bug, an authorisation-laundering path, caught by the court

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.defect: the binder delegated its exhaustive-coverage check to the adopted owner's private _Refusal type, leaking a foreign exception type into this binder's refusal surface
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.fix: the check is performed directly against candidate_class_coverage and raises this binder's own typed refusal, preserving the APPLICABILITY_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE reason code
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.class: real design defect, one refusal surface, caught by the court

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.defect: the two write-terrain guard tests computed the repository root as parents[2] instead of parents[1], so they silently SKIPPED and protected nothing

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.fix: corrected the path; both guards now execute and pass, and genuinely verify the three adopted blobs
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.class: test-quality defect of the GAP-3 family, caught by scrutiny rather than by a failure

defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.defect: six court assertions were wrong rather than the code: a defaulted None identity, a comparison of two identically-constructed rules asserted to differ, an index-0 assumption over F8's SORTED replay_determinants, a banned-substring scan that flagged the word 'unranked' as 'rank', a dir()-based public-surface check that swept in imported names, and a premise that a mislabelled receipt could be constructed at all when the adopted owner already refuses
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.detected_by: the first full court run: 9 failed, 62 passed
defects_this_lane_found_in_its_own_first.fix: each corrected against observed behaviour; the mislabelled-receipt case was rewritten to assert the STRONGER real property, that the receipt owner refuses to construct one at all
